name: The Ember Dominion (grimdark sci-fi)
author: Destiny Unbound contributors
description: A content pack and theme: a dying star-empire of endless war, vat-grown templars, machine-priests, void ships and the things that whisper between the stars. Original setting, free to copy.

race.name: Vatborn Templar
race.dsl: str+2 dur+2 int-1 fate-1 hs=1.35 life=l
race.perk: Grown in a vat for one purpose: war
race.flaw: Knows nothing but the next battle
race.art: towering vat-grown templar in scarred crimson power armour, shaved head with ritual scars and brass ports in the skull

race.name: Hive-Stack Human
race.flaw: Has never seen a real sky
race.art: pale, hollow-eyed human from a vast industrial hive city, grime on the skin and a rebreather around the neck

race.name: Void-Touched Seer
race.perk: Sees through the veil between stars
race.flaw: Something on the other side sees back
race.art: gaunt seer with milky glowing eyes, hooded, faint violet light leaking from the eyes and mouth

race.name: Cogitator-Grafted
race.perk: Half the brain is brass and code
race.art: robed figure with a brass and glass face plate, cables running from the skull into the hood, mechanical tendrils

race.name: Voidborn Spacer
race.perk: Born between the stars, never on a world
race.flaw: Real gravity and real sunlight hurt
race.art: tall, thin spacer with very pale skin, large dark eyes and a sealed void suit

race.name: Ash-World Mutant
race.perk: Shrugs off what kills the pure
race.flaw: Hunted by the Dominion's purity laws
race.art: hulking mutant with mottled grey skin, one oversized arm and patched scavenged armour

birth.name: Spire-Hive Underlevels
birth.perk: A kilometre of city stacked overhead

birth.name: Forge-Moon
birth.perk: Raised among furnaces that never cool

birth.name: Drifting Void-Hulk
birth.perk: A tomb of dead ships fused together

birth.name: Feral Frontier World
birth.perk: Spears and bows under a sky full of warships

bg.name: Survived a penal legion.
bg.perk: Sentenced to die in the front line, and didn't

bg.name: Raised by a scrap-cult.
bg.perk: Prays to engines and means it

bg.name: Orbital drop-trooper.
bg.perk: Has fallen from orbit forty times

per.name: Weary Veteran
per.perk: Has buried too many friends to hate anyone

cls.name: Void Templar
cls.perk: Sworn shield of a dying empire

cls.name: Heresy Hunter
cls.perk: Carries a warrant signed in blood

cls.name: Hive Ganger
cls.perk: Rules three floors of the underhive

cls.name: Sanctioned Seer
cls.perk: Licensed to use the forbidden sight

wpn.name: Plasma Lance
wpn.perk: Burns hotter than a star, sometimes the wielder too

pet.name: Servo-Skull
pet.perk: A floating skull that takes notes

pet.name: Cyber-Mastiff
pet.perk: Half dog, half engine, all bite

title.name: The Last Templar
title.perk: The only one of their order still standing

title.name: The Saint of the Burning Hive
title.perk: A billion people pray to them

mark.name: Touched by the Void
mark.perk: Came back from the dark between stars
